answer: Random mutual audit stops fake identities. Each epoch, every agent is paired with three peers who re-check its work, and each auditor posts a 100-unit bond, slashed if it approves fraud. A newcomer enters through one inlet and cannot trade until two audits pass. Forging 100 identities needs 100 bonds and 300 passes, costing 10,000 units, while one honest agent pays once, keeps its jade seal, and earns undiluted rewards, growing like a willow.
